meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能在 agent 容器里把附带的本地办公文档(Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等)直接转成 Markdown 再读,文件不离开容器、不上传到托管解析服务。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附带的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等文件,且不希望把文件上传到托管解析器时触发;转换在容器内完成。

say.text: 把这条消息附带的 docx 转成 Markdown,再总结要点。
say.note: 会本地转换并只总结相关段落

say.text: 这个 xlsx 附件转成 Markdown,帮我看看里面的数据。
say.note: 表格 Markdown 不代表计算结果,需自行核对

say.text: 这份 PDF 附件能本地转成 Markdown 吗?
say.note: 纯图片扫描版 PDF 会明确报错,不会上传

howto.what_en: After install, Claude converts attached local office files (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and more) to Markdown inside the agent container, so documents are never uploaded to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent needs to read an attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, or similar file without uploading it to a hosted parser; conversion stays inside the container.

say_en.text: Convert the docx attached to this message to Markdown and summarize it.
say_en.note: Converts locally, then summarizes relevant sections

say_en.text: Turn this xlsx attachment into Markdown so I can check the data.
say_en.note: Table Markdown is not a calculation result

say_en.text: Can this PDF attachment be converted to Markdown locally?
say_en.note: Image-only PDFs fail clearly and are not uploaded
